issue_request: FHIR-17972 was a Published/Persuasive Financial Management change request, applied for STU3, asking to add ExplanationOfBenefit.fundsReserve, or .reserve using ClaimResponse's definition, to ExplanationOfBenefit.

Later source refactors carried the element into the current StructureDefinition XML.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively builds ClaimResponse and ExplanationOfBenefit. Current EOB and ClaimResponse StructureDefinitions both contain fundsReserve, and fhir.ini maps old reserved names to fundsReserve for both resources. Later FM binding decisions, especially FHIR-53057, explain why current fundsReserve bindings are preferred rather than merely matching the original STU3-era wording. Community searches found no conflicting Zulip or Confluence context.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The active current source already has ExplanationOfBenefit.fundsReserve with 0..1 CodeableConcept cardinality and the fundsreserve value set, satisfying the Jira request. A generated-looking EOB SVG binding-strength title appears stale, but the authoritative XML source conveys the requested element and this issue does not justify hand-editing diagram artifacts.
